PM Modi to Inaugurate Pachpadra Refinery and Jaipur Metro Phase 2

Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Pachpadra Refinery and lay the foundation stone for Jaipur Metro Phase 2 on July 4. The refinery's inauguration was previously postponed due to a fire incident approximately two and a half months prior to the new date. This event marks significant infrastructure developments in the region, with both projects aiming to enhance industrial capacity and urban transportation.
